summary:
SIM Industries: DSV Dark Angel Fleet Command is an interactive spacecraft architecture and mission design project built for the Space Mission Design Game challenge. Inspired by NASA’s International Space Station (ISS), DART planetary defense, and Artemis lunar ISRU missions, it solves the $1.5T Earth-launch bottleneck via a Far-Side Lunar Foundry and Electromagnetic Mass Driver ($180B–$300B ecosystem):
• DSV Dark Angel (872m Class-VIII Dockyard): Eight times ISS length, featuring a 42.8+ MW solar skin, 24-unit enclosed Pulse-Net propulsion (8 bow, 12 stern, 4 ventral), Black Spear missiles, Zeus kinetic rods, and three docking bays (65m arms) that merge via retractable walls to hold 36 satellites.
• Project IVAN (218m Cruiser): Pivots four massive wings from Asteroid Mode into Combat Mode, unleashing a full-base laser, Zeus kinetic rods, Black Spear interceptors, and a Self-Healing Ice Shield.
• The Hand (218m / 900t Collector): Pairs a top telemetry antenna and central laser bore with a wide downward parabolic collector dish for -250°C crater mining.
• 40-Specialist Crew & 3-Class Robotics: Supported by Class 1 Viper vent serpents, Class 2 Scuttler 6-legged drill-blade commanders, and Class 3 Remora micro-drones.
Novus-1: 2-Wing Medic with AI and repairer of infected satellites.
Novus-2: 4-Wing Medic with better tech version of Novus-1.
details:
1. Executive Vision & Closed-Loop Lunar Manufacturing Architecture
SIM Industries: DSV Dark Angel Fleet Command presents an architectural and logistical design for deep-space missions. To bypass the trillion-dollar cost and massive launch requirements of lifting mega-structures from Earth, the project proposes a closed-loop Far-Side Lunar Foundry and Cis-Lunar Orbital Shipyard. By automating 3D printing, metal smelting, and polar water-ice refining in a subterranean lunar base—and launching structural canisters via an Electromagnetic Lunar Mass Driver—the 872-meter fleet is constructed in orbit for an estimated $180B–$300B.

2. Master Fleet & Interactive Gameplay Systems
The three-vessel fleet is structured for orbital assembly, planetary defense, and resource extraction:

  • DSV Dark Angel (872m × 420m × 75m Class-VIII Pulse-Net Dockyard): The 100,000-metric-ton mobile flagship and shipyard features regolith-obsidian stealth armor, a 42.8+ MW solar skin, and a 24-unit Pulse-Net propulsion array. It includes three modular docking bays with 65-meter robotic arms, retractable bulkhead walls for super-bay conversions, and six lateral cold-launch magazines for Black Spear missiles and Zeus kinetic rods. It also a dockyard station for satellites. Lastly, it's special thing is that it uses a movable wall with nets on both fronts and backs of the ship and uses plasma shockwaves that pushes the wall in order for the ship to move.
  • Project IVAN (218m / 900t Heavy Orbital Defense & Planetary Protection Cruiser): A dual-mode cruiser that operates in Deactivated Asteroid Mode (using folding wings and a Self-Healing Ice Shield for stealth transit) or Activated Combat Mode (unfolding wings to expose a downward high-energy laser system and kinetic interceptors).
  • The Hand (218m / 900t Deep-Crater Collector & Mining Satellite): A specialized mining and telemetry platform designed to operate in permanently shadowed lunar craters (-250°C), performing LiDAR/gamma-ray prospecting and subsurface water-ice extraction to refuel the fleet. The collectors comes out of the ship, collects the supplies, and travels to the DSV Dark Angel to give the supplies for them.

3. 40-Specialist Crew, Aegis-Net Quantum Firewall & 3-Class Robotics
Operations are managed by a 40-member crew across command, engineering, propulsion, and cybersecurity divisions. Security is maintained via the Aegis-Net Quantum Firewall and a "Code Black" emergency air-gap protocol. Maintenance relies on a three-tier robotics system:

  • Class 1 Viper: Articulated mechanical-claw serpents for internal ventilation and power conduit repairs. The Vipers also can infect enemy satellites with just their sharp teeth, so their like real snakes.
  • Class 2 Scuttler: Heavy 6-legged drill-blade units for exterior hull welding and docking bay refits. They also jump super high and also has the ability to fight.
  • Class 3 Remora: Agile micro-drones for solar-skin patrol and emergency stabilization. They can also protect satellites by swarming around it like a shield.
    NOVUS-1 (LEO CYBER-PHYSICAL ORBITAL MEDIC & ANTI-HIJACK SENTINEL): autonomous Low Earth Orbit (LEO) guardian spacecraft built to rescue silent, abandoned, and cyber-hijacked satellites before rogue commands weaponize them or turn them into space debris.
    Hardware Architecture: - 2.0-Meter Faraday-Shielded Metal Sphere: A brushed titanium/aluminum core (size of four refrigerators) housing an isolated malware sandboxing vault, onboard Edge AI, and spare-parts magazine. - Half-House-Sized Solar Wings (Two ~7-Meter Arrays): Generates ~10 kW of continuous power for electric ion thrusters, optical lasers, and robotic operations.
    - Dual Slender Robotic Arms (~1.8 m): Precision micro-manipulators that extend from the sphere to replace burnt-out mini-dishes, damaged antennas, and transponders. The 5-Step Cyber-Physical Rescue Loop: 1. SCAN: Cross-references NASA DONKI space weather alerts with optical/RF scans within 100 meters of a distressed satellite to distinguish solar flare glitches from active cyberattacks. 2.
    CLEAN: Beams a lightweight (<64 KB) self-deleting cleaner micro-program via optical laser to purge malware from the flight computer without needing the target's radio. 3. REPAIR: Extends slender robotic arms to swap out physically damaged mini-dishes or transponders using hardened spares. 4. UPGRADE: Uploads a next-generation (<48 KB) a really massive resident firewall that inspects incoming commands, locks thrusters against unauthorized weaponization, and blocks rogue terrorist attack commands.
    NOVUS-2 (QUAD-WING NEXT-GEN CYBER-PHYSICAL ORBITAL MEDIC — MK-II) Novus-2 is the upgraded Mk-II evolution of Novus-1—maintaining the same compact, agile satellite footprint while packing four X-wing solar arrays, long-range Quantum LiDAR sensors, and self-healing quantum firewalls to protect Low Earth Orbit constellations. Hardware Architecture: - 2.0-Meter Lunar-Titanium & Graphene Sphere: A Faraday-shielded core (same "four refrigerators" footprint as Novus-1) housing a Neuromorphic Quantum-Co-Processor, isolated malware sandboxing vault, and hardened spare-parts magazine. - Quad X-Wing Solar Arrays (Four ~7-Meter Wings): Four half-house-sized solar wings arranged in an X-configuration, generating ~35 kW of continuous power with zero solar blind spots during robotic repairs.
    - Dual Tactile Slender Robotic Arms (~1.8 m): Precision micro-manipulators upgraded with sub-millimeter force sensors and micro-laser welders to swap burnt-out mini-dishes, antennas, and fried transponders.
    Next-Gen Sensors & 5-Step Cyber-Physical Rescue Loop: 1. LONG-RANGE SCAN (5 km Quantum LiDAR): Detects hidden malware, rogue signals, and spoofed frequencies from up to 5 kilometers away while cross-referencing NASA DONKI space weather alerts to separate solar storm glitches from cyberattacks.
    2. CLEAN (Quantum Micro-Cleaner): Beams a lightweight (<32 KB) self-deleting cleaner micro-program via multi-beam optical laser to purge zero-day viruses without needing the target's main radio.
    3. REPAIR (Precision Hardware Swap): Extends tactile robotic arms to replace physically damaged mini-dishes or clip on hardware protection modules.
    4. UPGRADE (Self-Healing <16 KB Quantum Firewall): Installs an adaptive, quantum-encrypted micro-firewall that automatically mutates encryption keys if terrorists change attack frequencies, locking thrusters against weaponization.
    5. PATROL (Fleet Herd Immunity): Uses high-impulse Hall-Effect thrusters to hop between endangered satellites 3x faster and broadcast threat signatures across the orbital fleet.

4. How We Built It & NASA Open Data Integration
The project utilizes custom HTML/JS interactive controls, ASCII/CAD schematics, and a public GitHub repository (SIM-industries-Dark-Angel-project-IVAN-and-the-Hand). Subsystems draw on NASA data, scaling ISS modular truss and photovoltaic metrics, adapting DART kinetic impactor physics for planetary defense, and applying Artemis and VIPER polar prospecting data for lunar ISRU operations.
